items.text: DJ Moore (BUF) was limited Friday with the shoulder after missing Wednesday and Thursday, and Buffalo lists him questionable @LV. He is WR23 rest of season for me, and Keon Coleman, who caught a TD in Moore's absence @LAR, is WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Monitor Moore; Sunday's inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Ashton Jeanty (LV) practiced in full all three days with the foot and has no injury designation vs BUF. His touches have fallen four straight weeks, from 29 to 13, but the foot is not the worry Sunday. RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.
Brock Bowers (LV) was full Thursday and Friday after a limited Wednesday with the knee and has no injury designation vs BUF. TE1 for me this week.

Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) had 22 of Jacksonville's 24 running back carries in London in Week 5 on about two thirds of the snaps, and LeQuint Allen Jr. kept the passing downs. RB15 for me vs HOU this week, an RB2.
Jonathan Taylor (IND) played 71 and 73 percent of the snaps the last two weeks, down from 89 percent in Week 1, with Seth McGowan near 30 percent. RB3 for me vs TEN this week.

Kendre Miller (NO) had all 4 of New Orleans' red-zone carries vs MIN while Alvin Kamara played 12 snaps with the back, and Kamara is questionable @NYG. Miller is RB32 for me, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play.

Kimani Vidal (LAC) led the Chargers' backs in snaps for the first time vs DEN, 42 percent, after 7, 10, 25 and 35 percent the first four weeks, and ran 8 times for 57 and a TD. RB38 for me @KC, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
Pat Freiermuth (PIT) caught 5 for 44 and 2 TDs vs IND, and Pittsburgh plays @TB without Michael Pittman Jr., Roman Wilson and Ben Skowronek. TE13 for me, a streamer this week.

MarShawn Lloyd (GB) scored twice on 10 carries vs CHI and had 42 percent of Green Bay's running back touches, with Josh Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List. RB22 for me vs DAL this week, an RB2, and RB41 rest of season.

items.watch: his route share @JAX Sunday at 9:30 AM ET
items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. (HOU) makes his Houston debut @JAX in London as the No. 2 outside receiver next to Nico Collins, after 5 catches for 85 in four games with Arizona and an inactive Week 5. He is off my Week 6 list and WR43 rest of season. Monitor; his route share Sunday at 9:30 AM ET.

items.watch: next week's practice reports, whether he can grip the ball
items.text: Baker Mayfield (TB) will not play vs PIT with the dislocated right thumb, and Jalon Daniels makes a third straight start. Daniels is QB27 for me, outside my top 12, and Mayfield is QB24 rest of season. Monitor; next week's practice reports, to see if he can grip the ball.

Emanuel Wilson (SEA) got 14 carries for 52 yards in the 17-14 overtime loss @DEN, but he played only 33 percent of the snaps and ran 9 routes. George Holani played 56 percent and ran 27 routes on Darnold's 51 throws. With Zach Charbonnet close to coming off PUP, Wilson is RB59 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

items.why: The call changes if Seattle leaves him on PUP through Week 7.
items.text: Zach Charbonnet (SEA) sat out a second game on PUP with the knee, and no Seattle back cleared 56 percent of the snaps @DEN without him. He is RB47 rest of season for me. Hold him; the call changes if Seattle leaves him on PUP through Week 7.

items.why: The call changes if the shoulder costs him practice time next week.
items.text: Jaylen Waddle (DEN) caught 4 of 7 targets for 24 yards vs SEA, with a 29 percent target share and a route on 80 percent of Bo Nix's dropbacks, in a game where Nix threw for 107 yards. He left briefly with the shoulder and came back. He is WR15 rest of season for me. Hold him; the call changes if the shoulder costs him practice time next week.

items.why: The call changes if his route share drops under a third of the dropbacks again in Week 7.
items.text: RJ Harvey (DEN) got 4 targets and ran a route on 40 percent of the dropbacks vs SEA after 1 target in Week 5, with 6 carries for 25 yards, a rushing touchdown and 3 catches for 31. J.K. Dobbins played 54 percent of the snaps to Harvey's 37 and ran 17 times for 41 and a score. Harvey is RB33 rest of season for me, Dobbins RB36. Hold Harvey; the call changes if his route share drops under a third of the dropbacks again in Week 7.

Seattle's inactives @DEN are out: Robert Henry sits, and Emanuel Wilson leads a three-back group with George Holani and Velus Jones Jr. while Zach Charbonnet is out. Wilson had 20 of the 24 running back carries vs SF. He is RB16 for me tonight, an RB2.

Jalen Hurts (PHI) is ruled out vs CAR with the calf after a full practice Wednesday and none Thursday, on the Eagles' report, and Tanner McKee starts. Hurts comes off the Menu and stays QB9 rest of season. Pivot to Tyler Shough, QB12 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week.
David Montgomery (HOU) is ruled out @JAX with the groin and will not travel to London. Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps once Montgomery left at TEN. Pivot to Marks, RB20 for me, an RB2.

Mike Evans (SF) did not practice Thursday with the ribs and Achilles, per Kyle Shanahan, with Deebo Samuel already out. Evans is WR12 for me vs WAS, borderline WR1/WR2, for now. Monitor; Saturday's injury report before Monday night.
Rashee Rice (KC) missed practice again Thursday with the hamstring and knee. He is WR27 for me vs LAC, a high-end WR3, and a sit without a full practice Friday. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Chris Olave (NO) missed a second straight practice with the illness. He stays WR6 for me @NYG for now. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) did not practice Thursday either with the ankle, per local reporters. He is RB18 for me @LAR, an RB2, only if he practices Friday, and Tyler Allgeier (RB36) is the pivot. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Lamar Jackson (BAL) missed practice again Thursday with the ankle, and Tyler Huntley starts @CLE if he sits. Jackson is QB15 for me this week, a streamer. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Caleb Williams (CHI) practiced in full Thursday off the hamstring, after a full estimate Wednesday. He is QB8 for me @ATL.
Michael Penix Jr. (ATL) practiced in full Thursday with the ribs and starts vs CHI. He is QB21 for me, outside my top 12; Drake London stays WR5.
DeVonta Smith (PHI) went from no practice Wednesday to limited Thursday with the hamstring and toe, and Tanner McKee is his quarterback vs CAR. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) missed practice Wednesday and Thursday with the hamstring. Dameon Pierce had 11 carries as the last healthy back in Week 5 and is RB30 for me, a high-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Christian Kirk (SF) had his 21-day IR window opened and was limited Thursday, per Kyle Shanahan, with Mike Evans hurt and Deebo Samuel out. Monitor; his activation from IR.
Stefon Diggs (WAS) did not practice Thursday with the hamstring, per Dan Quinn, ahead of Monday night @SF. Monitor; Saturday's injury report.
Tyjae Spears (TEN) was downgraded to no practice Thursday with the knee. He is RB40 for me @IND, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, and Tony Pollard is RB21, an RB2.
Dylan Sampson (CLE) was upgraded to limited Thursday off IR while Quinshon Judkins (RB33 for me) missed practice again with the ankle. Stash Sampson, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

DJ Moore (BUF) did not practice Wednesday with the AC joint sprain in his shoulder, after sitting Week 5 @LAR off one limited session. Keon Coleman caught 1 of 2 targets for a 7-yard TD without him. Moore needs a practice before he is in the lineup range @LV. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Baker Mayfield (TB) missed the open part of Thursday's practice too with the dislocated right thumb, per reporters at the facility, so Jalon Daniels is in line for a third straight start vs PIT. Daniels is QB27 for me, outside my top 12, and Mayfield is QB24 rest of season. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA) practiced in full Wednesday with the ankle and has no game designation for Thursday @DEN, on Seattle's official report. He is WR2 for me with a 37.9 percent target share through Week 3.

David Montgomery (HOU) did not practice Wednesday with the groin he hurt at TEN, and DeMeco Ryans calls him week to week. Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps after Montgomery left and is RB20 for me @JAX in London, an RB2.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring that kept him out in London, per the Eagles' report and ESPN's Tim McManus. Dameon Pierce had 11 carries for 14 as the last healthy back in Week 5. Monitor; Friday's injury report decides Barkley vs CAR.

DeVonta Smith (PHI) did individual work but was a non-participant Wednesday with the hamstring, per ESPN's Tim McManus and the Eagles' report. He missed Week 5 in London. Monitor; Friday's injury report decides Smith vs CAR.
CeeDee Lamb (DAL) practiced in full Wednesday, three days after the quad bruise vs TB. He is WR3 for me @GB Sunday night.
Chris Olave (NO) did not practice Wednesday with an illness, on the Saints' official report. He stays WR6 for me @NYG for now. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Alvin Kamara (NO) was limited Wednesday with the back that held him to 12 snaps vs MIN, and Kendre Miller (RB32 for me) took 10 carries in that game. Kamara is RB26 for me @NYG, a high-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Tyler Shough (NO) was a full participant Wednesday with the left hand. He is QB13 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week; stream him.
Breece Hall (NYJ) is still week to week with the quad and likely out @NE. Braelon Allen played all but two snaps with Hall out in Week 4. Allen is RB19 for me this week, an RB2.

Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that Ashton Jeanty (LV) is playing vs BUF through the foot. His touches have fallen four straight weeks, from 29 to 13. Jeanty is RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) sat out Wednesday's practice to rest the ankle, and Tyler Allgeier (RB36 for me) kept the passing downs vs DET. Love is RB18 for me @LAR, an RB2, while he practices by Friday. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) has not practiced since he hurt the ankle Oct. 4, Wednesday included, and Tyler Huntley starts @CLE if he sits. Jackson drops to QB16 for me this week, a streamer, and stays QB2 rest of season. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
Caleb Williams (CHI) was a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report off the hamstring after sitting out Week 5. Williams climbs to QB8 for me @ATL this week.

Quinshon Judkins (CLE) is out of the walking boot but did not practice Wednesday with the right ankle, and Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime are behind him. Judkins falls to RB33 for me vs BAL, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play. Monitor; Thursday's and Friday's injury reports.
Rashee Rice (KC) did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring. He moves up to WR27 for me vs LAC, a high-end WR3, but without a full practice by Friday he is a sit. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) did not practice Wednesday and has not practiced since he hurt the ankle Oct. 4; Adam Schefter reports a realistic chance he plays @CLE, and Tyler Huntley starts if he cannot. Jackson is QB16 for me this week, a streamer, and QB2 rest of season. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Michael Penix Jr. (ATL) practiced Wednesday with the ribs, and Kevin Stefanski said he is the starter vs CHI as long as everything goes to plan. Drake London had 96 and 194 yards in his two full games with Penix. Penix is QB22 for me this week, outside my top 12, and QB23 rest of season. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Caleb Williams (CHI) was a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report with the hamstring, though Ben Johnson still calls his status fluid. Tyson Bagent started Week 5 and Case Keenum relieved him. Williams is QB8 for me @ATL this week, and QB10 rest of season. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Rashee Rice (KC) did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring, and Kansas City put Justin Watson on the practice squad, not the active roster, with Tyquan Thornton on IR. Rice is WR27 for me vs LAC, a high-end WR3 play to a dart throw; without a full practice by Friday, sit him. Monitor; Thursday's and Friday's practice reports.

items.watch: his activation from IR, by Saturday's roster moves
items.text: A.J. Brown (NE) practiced Wednesday, opening his 21-day IR window, and Mack Hollins is on IR with the calf through at least Week 8. Brown takes the top target role the day he is active. He is WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; his activation from IR by Saturday's roster moves.

Ja'Kobi Lane (BAL) is back at practice off IR after wrist surgery, and the team site lists him as activated. Expect a small No. 3 share behind Zay Flowers and Rashod Bateman at first. WR75 rest of season for me. Monitor; his route share @CLE Sunday.

Cleveland designated Dylan Sampson (CLE) to return from IR, and he practiced Wednesday while Quinshon Judkins sat out with the ankle. With Raheim Sanders on IR, Sampson is next in line once active. RB67 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Jordan Mason (MIN) has been on IR with the thumb since Sept. 16 and is expected back in Week 7 after the bye. Aaron Jones Sr. ran 25 times for 113 and a TD @NO with the job to himself, and Mason takes carries and goal-line work back from him. RB35 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Chase Brown (CIN) ran 13 times for 38 @MIA to Samaje Perine's 14 for 68, and OC Dan Pitcher said the team will keep assessing how the touches split. Brown still out-snapped Perine 38 to 33. RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer an RB2 and a WR3.

Baker Mayfield (TB) was not on the field for Wednesday's practice with the dislocated right thumb, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports, and Mike Garafolo of NFL Network says he is unlikely to play vs PIT. Jalon Daniels, 19 of 25 for 189 in the Week 5 win @DAL, is in line for a third start and is outside my top 12, a sit. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Quinshon Judkins (CLE) was out of the walking boot on his right ankle in the locker room Wednesday but will not practice, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN. With Raheim Sanders on IR, Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime are behind him. He is RB33 for me vs BAL this week, a low-end RB3, until he practices. Monitor; Thursday's and Friday's injury reports.

Cleveland put Raheim Sanders (CLE) on IR Tuesday with the hip he hurt @NYJ, so he misses at least four games, and signed Audric Estime off Minnesota's practice squad. Sanders is RB79 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list, or move him to an IR spot.
